verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs say Pods can use custom containers pulled from any compatible registry (Docker Hub, GHCR, ECR), and the CLI accepts an arbitrary image via `--image`. Templates are described as pre-configured Docker image setups, and they can be managed, along with registries, through the CLI and REST API, so developers can bring their exact environment. Missing for 10: an explicit walkthrough of creating a custom template and of authenticating to a private registry, and independent or hands-on confirmation of running a user's own image (community comments only mention using third-party templates).

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my own Docker image or custom machine template with my exact environment
